priorityList: Interrupt with Spear Hand Strike when the target is casting.
Use Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally aligned with Zenith or when the fight is ending.
Cast Zenith if Xuen is active, during Bloodlust, or to align with major cooldowns (Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury).
Cast Celestial Conduit while Zenith is active and your primary strikes (Rising Sun Kick, Fists of Fury, and Strike of the Windlord) are on cooldown.
Use Whirling Dragon Punch if both Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury are on cooldown.
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, ideally during Zenith windows.
Cast Fists of Fury on cooldown, prioritizing windows where Heart of the Jade Serpent is active or at maximum Flurry Charges.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Rising Sun Kick on cooldown.
Use Spinning Crane Kick when Dance of Chi-Ji is active, especially if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Combo Breaker.
Use Touch of Death on targets below the health threshold or when the fight is about to end.
Cast Blackout Kick if you have a Combo Breaker proc, are at high Chi, or to maintain Combo Strikes.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi when you are below 4 Chi and nearing maximum Energy.
Cast Slicing Winds as a filler when available.
Always alternate abilities to maintain the Combo Strikes Mastery; never use the same ability twice in a row.
